name: BPC-157
summary: BPC-157 is a synthetic 15-amino-acid peptide with the sequence GEPPPGKPADDAGLV. Papers describe it as a fragment related to a protein isolated from human gastric juice. Rodent studies report cytoprotective and wound-healing effects in gastrointestinal and musculoskeletal models. Human efficacy is not established in published controlled trials. There is no registered SAHPRA medicine for this peptide. SAHPRA names BPC-157 among illegally marketed unregistered peptides. The 2026 WADA Prohibited List names BPC-157 under S0 Non-approved substances.

research_uses.use: Musculoskeletal soft-tissue healing models (tendon, ligament, and skeletal muscle in rodents and in vitro tendon fibroblasts)

sources.title: Gastric pentadecapeptide BPC 157 accelerates healing of transected rat Achilles tendon and in vitro stimulates tendocytes growth
sources.quote: In studies intended to improve healing of transected Achilles tendon, effective was a stable gastric pentadecapeptide BPC 157 (GEPPPGKPADDAGLV, M.W. 1419).

sources.title: The promoting effect of pentadecapeptide BPC 157 on tendon healing involves tendon outgrowth, cell survival, and cell migration
sources.quote: Pentadecapeptide BPC 157, composed of 15 amino acids, is a partial sequence of body protection compound (BPC) that is discovered in and isolated from human gastric juice.

sources.title: Effective therapy of transected quadriceps muscle in rat: Gastric pentadecapeptide BPC 157
sources.quote: BPC 157 (10 microg, 10 ng, 10 pg/kg) is given intraperitoneally, once daily; the first application 30 min posttransection, the final 24 h before sacrifice.

sources.title: Gastric pentadecapeptide body protection compound BPC 157 and its role in accelerating musculoskeletal soft tissue healing
sources.quote: However, to date, the majority of studies have been performed on small rodent models and the efficacy of BPC 157 is yet to be confirmed in humans.

research_uses.use: Gastrointestinal cytoprotection and inflammatory-bowel-disease models (rodent; early Pliva PL 14736 clinical work is not a completed registration trial)

sources.title: The pharmacological properties of the novel peptide BPC 157 (PL-10)
sources.quote: The reported beneficial effects of the gastric mucosal derived pentadecapeptide BPC 157 (Gly Glu Pro Pro Pro Gly Lys Pro Ala Asp Asp Ala Gly Leu Val, M.W. 1419) on different organ lesions are reviewed.

sources.title: Stable gastric pentadecapeptide BPC 157 in trials for inflammatory bowel disease (PL-10, PLD-116, PL 14736, Pliva, Croatia)
sources.quote: Gastric pentadecapeptide BPC 157 (GEPPPGKPADDAGLV, M.W. 1419, safe in clinical trials for inflammatory bowel disease (PL 10, PLD 116, PLD 14736, Pliva, Croatia)) has a particular cytoprotective/adaptive cytoprotective activity.

sources.title: Focus on ulcerative colitis: stable gastric pentadecapeptide BPC 157
sources.quote: Stable gastric pentadecapeptide BPC 157 (GEPPPGKPADDAGLV, M.W. 1419) may be the new drug stable in human gastric juice, effective both in the upper and lower GI tract, and free of side effects.

reported_protocols.amount: 10 µg/kg, 10 ng/kg, or 10 pg/kg as reported
reported_protocols.duration: first dose 30 min after surgery; last dose 24 h before autopsy; assessments through day 14 as reported
reported_protocols.context: Commonly reported research protocol in a rat Achilles-tendon transection model (intraperitoneal, saline, no carrier). Not a human instruction.

sources.title: Gastric pentadecapeptide BPC 157 accelerates healing of transected rat Achilles tendon and in vitro stimulates tendocytes growth
sources.quote: Agents (/kg b.w., i.p., once time daily) (BPC 157 (dissolved in saline, with no carrier addition) (10 microg, 10 ng or 10 pg) or saline (5.0 ml)), were firstly applied at 30 min after surgery, the last application at 24 h before autopsy.

reported_protocols.amount: 10 µg/kg, 10 ng/kg, or 10 pg/kg as reported
reported_protocols.duration: first dose 30 min after transection; last dose 24 h before sacrifice; assessments through 72 days as reported
reported_protocols.context: Commonly reported research protocol in a rat quadriceps-muscle transection model (intraperitoneal). Not a human instruction.

sources.title: Effective therapy of transected quadriceps muscle in rat: Gastric pentadecapeptide BPC 157
sources.quote: BPC 157 (10 microg, 10 ng, 10 pg/kg) is given intraperitoneally, once daily; the first application 30 min posttransection, the final 24 h before sacrifice. It consistently improves muscle healing throughout the whole 72-day period.

sahpra.notes: SAHPRA public warning (2026) names BPC-157 among illegally marketed unregistered peptides. That is not a registered-medicine listing and is not legal advice.

sources.title: SAHPRA peptide products public information
sources.quote: Illegally marketed peptides include: BPC-157, TB-500, Melanotan II, CJC-1295, Ipamorelin, PT-141, AOD-9604, Selank, and Semax.

wada.notes: Named example under S0 Non-approved substances on the official 2026 Prohibited List. Prohibited at all times. Athlete status only; not a buying rule.

sources.title: WADA Prohibited List
sources.quote: This class covers many different substances including but not limited to BPC-157, 2,4-dinitrophenol (DNP), ryanodine receptor-1-calstabin complex stabilizers [e.g. S-107, S48168 (ARM210)] and troponin activators (e.g. reldesemtiv and tirasemtiv).

stack_pair_notes.note: South African research storefronts often list BPC-157 with TB-500 as a named pair. That is a catalog convention, not a protocol.
